query: My living room gets a lot of sunlight. Should I get an OLED or a QLED TV?
atoms: burn-in risk for mixed content use
color accuracy and wide color gamut
plausible_answers: Answer A (QLED for Bright Room Default): Get a QLED TV — in a sunlit living room, QLED's 1,500–2,000 nit brightness overwhelmingly outperforms OLED, which loses its contrast advantage completely when ambient light washes out dark scenes.

Answer B (MLA OLED as Exception): Consider an MLA-equipped OLED (LG G3 or similar) if you want the best picture quality and your room isn't in direct sunlight — new MLA technology pushes brightness high enough to handle most bright room conditions.

Answer C (OLED for Dark/Evening Use): Choose OLED if most of your TV watching happens in the evening with controlled lighting — the infinite contrast and perfect blacks provide a dramatically superior picture that justifies accepting the bright-room limitation.
